title: Quenched Smoky Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A dense, midnight-craving stew that blends smoky flavors, sous‑vide tenderness, and a creamy semi‑skimmed milk reduction for a comforting Uruguayan experience.
instructions: Pat the beef cubes dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine beef cubes with smoked paprika, liquid smoke, minced garlic, salt, and pepper; let marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium‑high heat; sear beef cubes until browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion until translucent, then stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add semi‑skimmed milk and beef stock, whisking to combine, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Transfer the beef, onion, and sauce mixture into a vacuum‑sealed bag, add thyme sprigs and bay leaves, and seal.
Place the bag in a sous‑vide water bath set to 57°C (135°F) and cook for 24 hours.
After sous‑vide, remove the bag, squeeze out excess liquid, and return the beef to the skillet.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 30 minutes to reduce and thicken slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Divide the stew among four plates and serve hot.
